description: This file defines the Vtiger_LanguageImport class, which provides an API for importing language modules into the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for initializing import, processing zip files, and updating language modules, along with specific logic for handling language files and related resources.

classes.name: Vtiger_LanguageImport
classes.description: A class that manages the process of importing language files and modules into the CRM, inheriting from Vtiger_LanguageExport, with methods for import, update, and handling specific language file logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the language prefix defined in the module XML.

methods.name: initImport
methods.description: Initializes the import process with the given zip file, setting up schema and extracting module name.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles the entire import process for a language module zip file, supporting overwriting.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the language module instance using the provided zip file.

methods.name: import_Language
methods.description: Main method that processes the language files from the zip, copying relevant language files based on naming conventions and directory structure.
